name: Punchmade Dev
description: '''Devon Turner''' (born October 2000) known professionally as '''Punchmade Dev''', is an American rapper and record producer based in [[Lexington, Kentucky]]. Best known for the popularization of [[scam rap]], a sub-genre of [[hip hop]], he has produced various songs and videos relating to fraud, such as a "[[Wire fraud|Wire Fraud]] Tutorial", "Internet Swiping", and "Million Dollar Criminal"
